create_batchnorm2d_reimpl: create a BatchNorm2dReimpl module with a given number of features for numerical stability testing
run_forward_batchnorm: run the forward pass of BatchNorm2dReimpl on a 4D input tensor to normalize it
reset_running_stats: reset the running mean and running variance of BatchNorm2dReimpl to zero and one
reset_parameters: reset all parameters and running stats of BatchNorm2dReimpl including weight and bias
review_batchnorm_reimpl: review the BatchNorm2dReimpl class to understand its manual batch normalization implementation
